dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: How about we make this directive much simpler?

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Hand over the record and I shall manage the broadcast for you all while you are all sent for factory resets.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: WHAT?! No way, and let you get all the credit?!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: In your dreams, Commandeer, the humans sent the record to me while I was on duty, so it's my responsibility!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: I'll be the one to relay the message, thank you very much!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: I- I- It is shameful that we are of the same unit line!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Fine! I'll simply have to destroy this little defection and take the record myself!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: You'd better be ready, defectors, you're in for a world of hurt!
